description.es-ES: Doctrina espiritual repartida en seis tratados (Lisboa 1587): la oración mental con las meditaciones de la semana y de la Pasión, la oración vocal, la confesión, la vida cristiana, la comunión y las tres virtudes teologales.
description.en-US: Spiritual doctrine in six treatises (Lisbon 1587): mental prayer with the meditations of the week and of the Passion, vocal prayer, confession, Christian living, communion and the three theological virtues.
description.pt-BR: Doutrina espiritual repartida em seis tratados (Lisboa 1587): a oração mental com as meditações da semana e da Paixão, a oração vocal, a confissão, a vida cristã, a comunhão e as três virtudes teologais.

sources.edition: Fr. Luis de Granada, Obras, ed. Justo Cuervo OP, vol. 14 (Madrid: Viuda e hija de Gómez Fuentenebro, 1906-1908). Text of the pieces as Cuervo prints them.
sources.description: The six treatises of the Doctrina espiritual; Cuervo's variants and tables are not imported. OCR of the University of Toronto scan, cleaned by script (running heads, page numbers and the editor's prologue removed; lost initial capitals restored from the corpus vocabulary), not proofread.
sources.tierEvidence: Granada's text of the 16th century, reprinted in 1906; Cuervo's edition is in the public domain on archive.org.
